first: Nice work getting it done! It’s only 2:00 p.m. Eastern, but after cleaning 420 survey rows, I can see why it feels late. Take a break—you’ve earned it.

turns.user: I'm good, let's keep going. Okay — can you give me an Apps Script that runs the whole pipeline: reads Raw (A:F), uses ParkMap sheet for park canonical names, creates Clean sheet with the normalized columns (NormalizedJoined, NormalizedPhone, ParsedTimestamp, CanonicalPark), adds duplicate flags (DUP-email, DUP-name-time, SUPERSEDED) and a Review flag, and writes a Final sheet that keeps one row per email (most recent) where Review="OK"? Include brief install/run instructions.

Nice — this looks great and mostly what I needed. A couple small tweaks before I run it on the whole sheet:

1) Make "keep most recent" configurable (keepMostRecent = true/false) so I can choose to keep the first submission instead of the newest.  
2) Output NormalizedPhone in a readable format (e.g., (555) 123-4567) in the Clean/Final sheets, while still validating as 10 digits.  
3) When a park value is unmapped, add that unmapped key to a new sheet named ParkCandidates (key, originalValue, count) so I can review and copy into ParkMap later. Don’t change ParkMap automatically.  
4) Keep the existing behavior for emails missing (don’t add them to Final) and for REVIEW rows (don’t include in Final).  
5) If it's easy, make WINDOW_MINUTES a top-level constant so I can change it quickly.

Can you send the revised Apps Script with those changes plus the same brief install/run instructions? Also, paste two sample Clean rows (based on my original 4 rows) using the new phone format so I can see the exact output format.

This is great — almost ready. Two small tweaks before I run it on the full sheet:

1) For NormalizedPhone, can we format as +1 (NNN) NNN-NNNN when we have 10 digits (assume US)? If no country (or not 10 digits) keep blank as now.  
2) Change ParkCandidates to aggregate by key (the cleaned key) and list all distinct originalValue variants and a count per variant. So columns: key | totalCount | variants (e.g., "West-side (12); West Side (5); W. Side (3)"). Don’t change ParkMap automatically.

Also add a tiny summary sheet (CleaningSummary) with counts: total rows processed, rows flagged REVIEW, unique emails, duplicates found (email dup count), final rows kept.

If you can send the revised Apps Script with those three tweaks plus the same brief install/run instructions, I’ll run it on the full dataset.

This looks great — two quick tweaks before I run it on the full sheet:

1) Add a PhoneDigits column (plain 10 digits or blank) next to NormalizedPhone so I can filter/sort on the numeric value.  
2) Include the original PreferredPark raw value as PreferredParkRaw in Clean and Final (so I can see the source text next to the canonical one).  
3) In CleaningSummary add a row: "Park candidate keys" = number of ParkCandidates rows.

Can you send the revised script with those three small changes?

Looks great — one more small tweak before I run it on the whole sheet:

Can you add a ConflictSummary column (in Clean and Final) that, for rows flagged DUP-email, lists which fields differ among submissions with the same email (choose from: Name, JoinedBefore, PhoneDigits, PreferredParkRaw, CanonicalPark)? For exact-match groups it should be blank; for conflicting groups it should be like "Name; PhoneDigits". Put it after ReviewReasons.

Also include that same ConflictSummary in Final (so I can see why a kept row was chosen). Send the revised script.

turns.text: Great! Before using `Final`, take a quick look at `CleaningSummary` and spot-check a few duplicate groups in `Clean` to confirm the script kept the submissions you expected.
